keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Bristol City 1, Wolverhampton Wanderers 0. Scott Twine (Bristol City) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Marshall Munetsi (Wolverhampton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Bristol City 1, Wolverhampton Wanderers 0.
Second Half begins Bristol City 1, Wolverhampton Wanderers 0.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Rodrigo Gomes replaces Marshall Munetsi.
Substitution, Bristol City. Yu Hirakawa replaces Sam Bell.
Cameron Pring (Bristol City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Bristol City. Jed Wallace replaces Rio Cardines.
Substitution, Bristol City. Dom Ballard replaces Scott Twine.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Mateus Mané replaces Rafiki Saïd.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Sean Neave replaces Fer López.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Tommy Doyle replaces Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
Goal! Bristol City 1, Wolverhampton Wanderers 1. Sean Neave (Wolverhampton Wanderers) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Tawanda Chirewa replaces Adam Armstrong.
Substitution, Bristol City. Adam Randell replaces Joe Williams.
Luke McNally (Bristol City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Bristol City 1, Wolverhampton Wanderers 2. Sean Neave (Wolverhampton Wanderers) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ladislav Krejcí following a set piece situation.
